info.title: Kauro API
info.description: Generated by tools/openapi.mjs; do not edit. Operations come from the vendored registry commands.json (provenance-verified); request schemas, the response views derived from the registry contracts, the envelopes and the Problem document are the application-owned schemas the api's closed validator compiles and its send guard validates every reply with.

post.description:
Precondition: No existing membership is assumed. The identity must be verified and creation abuse limits must admit the request.

TeamMemberView.title: TeamMemberView

It does not expose authentication provider tokens, recovery settings or another member's private security evidence"; re-check finding N16). A caller who manages the team sees every membership with its lifecycle times; any other member sees the ACTIVE team's roles.
TeamMemberView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Membership. Withheld: agencyId (The path names the agency every listed membership belongs to.); userId (Another person's identity reference is not team information appropriate to every caller; the caller's own membership is marked self.); assurancePolicy (The membership's authentication-strength configuration is security configuration, not team information (10: no recovery settings or security evidence).)

self.description: Whether this is the caller's own membership.

createdAt.description: When the membership was created; shown to a caller who manages the team.

CorrelationId.description: The correlation id of the request, on every reply.

CacheControl.description: Every reply is private (08 "Browser, API and cache isolation": private responses use an explicit no-shared-cache policy): it is never stored by a shared or a private cache.
